subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical shared fix for this issue, or ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to be refreshed as the direct issue-specific PR?
rationale: The bug is valid and source-reproducible, but overlapping open PRs target the same gap with different freshness and scope, so the landing path should be chosen before cleanup or new repair work.

options.title: Use the current-file shared PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require proof/CI there before closing this issue.

options.title: Refresh the direct PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to rebase or port from the old `pi-*` files if maintainers prefer the reporter's issue-specific branch.

options.title: Split Feishu residuals
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to the read-image bridge while leaving Feishu streaming-card and fallback-security residuals to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94894 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98250.

recommendation.title: Use the current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require proof/CI there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-runtime media refactor history and current-file ownership make this the best available routing owner for choosing the canonical landing path.
